[[File:DF2014-interface-main.png|right|500px]]
The game interface is made up of several different parts. In the screenshot you will notice:

* '''A''': The left panel is the main game area.
* '''B''': The right panel displays the game [[Menu]] and indicating the relevant hot keys.
* '''C''': The latters indicated new [[Reports]].  Press {{k|r}} to view these reports.  A red 'C' means combat, a green 'H' means hunting, and a blue 'S' means sparring.
* '''D''': The number of idle dwarves and current [[calendar|date]]. <!-- This may appear at the top right instead of bottom right. -->
* '''E''': The [[z-level]] you are currently viewing. Above z-level counter column, at top right, there is a moon phase indicator.

You can press {{K|tab}} to bring another panel that shows a mini-map of your embark site.
